XDual.name: Kum.XDual
XDual.statement:
def XDual (N : ℕ) (U : Subgroup (G F Ω)) (R M : Type) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] : Submodule R (U → M) where
  carrier := {φ | IsLocallyConstant φ ∧ (∀ a b, φ (a * b) = φ a + φ b) ∧
    (∀ (A : ValuationSubring Ω) (u : U), u.1 ∈ Ine (F := F) A → φ u = 0) ∧
    ∀ A : ValuationSubring Ω, A.valuation (N : Ω) < 1 → ∀ u : U, u.1 ∈ Dec (F := F) A → φ u = 0}
  zero_mem' := ⟨IsLocallyConstant.const _, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
  add_mem' {a b} ha hb := ⟨ha.1.add hb.1, fun x y => by simp only [Pi.add_apply, ha.2.1, hb.2.1]; abel,
    fun A u h => by simp [ha.2.2.1 A u h, hb.2.2.1 A u h],
    fun A hA u h => by simp [ha.2.2.2 A hA u h, hb.2.2.2 A hA u h]⟩
  smul_mem' c a ha := ⟨ha.1.comp (c • ·), fun x y => by simp [ha.2.1], fun A u h => by simp [ha.2.2.1 A u h],
    fun A hA u h => by simp [ha.2.2.2 A hA u h]⟩

Dinf.name: Kum.Dinf
Dinf.statement: abbrev Dinf (N : ℕ) (U : Subgroup (G F Ω)) : Submodule ℤ_[l] (cycU l U → QZ l) := XDual N (cycU l U) ℤ_[l] (QZ l)

Xinf.name: Kum.Xinf
Xinf.statement: abbrev Xinf (N : ℕ) (U : Subgroup (G F Ω)) : Type := Dinf l N U →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l

funRep.name: Kum.funRep
funRep.statement:
def funRep (U : Subgroup (G F Ω)) [U.Normal] : Representation R (G F Ω) (U → M) where
  toFun g := LinearMap.funLeft R M (conjHom U g)
  map_one' := LinearMap.ext fun φ => funext fun u => congrArg φ (Subtype.ext (by simp [conjHom]))
  map_mul' g h := LinearMap.ext fun φ => funext fun u => congrArg φ (Subtype.ext (by simp [conjHom, mul_assoc]))

conjCond.name: Kum.conjCond
conjCond.statement:
def conjCond (U : Subgroup (G F Ω)) (σ : Ω ≃+* Ω) (T : M →ₗ[R] M) : Submodule R (U → M) where
  carrier := {φ | ∀ u u' : U, (∀ x, u'.1 (σ x) = σ (u.1 x)) → φ u' = T (φ u)}
  zero_mem' := by intro u u' _; simp
  add_mem' {a b} ha hb u u' h := by simp [ha u u' h, hb u u' h]
  smul_mem' c a ha u u' h := by simp [ha u u' h]

EqHom.name: Kum.EqHom
EqHom.statement:
def EqHom (N : ℕ) (U : Subgroup (G F Ω)) (ρ : Representation R (G F Ω) M) : Submodule R (U → M) :=
  XDual N U R M ⊓ ⨅ g : G F Ω, conjCond U g.toRingEquiv (ρ g)

Un.name: Kum.Un
Un.statement: abbrev Un (n : ℕ) : Subgroup (G F Ω) := levU l ⊤ n

funRepMem.name: Kum.funRepMem
funRepMem.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Kum.funRepMem :
    ∀ (F Ω : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω] [IsAlgClosure F Ω] (N : ℕ) (U : Subgroup (G F Ω)) [U.Normal] (R M : Type) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M], (∀ g, ∀ φ ∈ XDual N U R M, funRep R M U g φ ∈ XDual N U R M) ∧ (∀ g ∈ U, ∀ φ ∈ XDual N U R M, funRep R M U g φ = φ) ∧
    ∀ (ρ : Representation R (G F Ω) M) (φ : U → M), φ ∈ EqHom N U ρ ↔ φ ∈ XDual N U R M ∧ ∀ g u, ρ g (funRep R M U g φ u) = φ u

memPrinc.name: mem_princ_iff_pow_dvd_sub_one
memPrinc.statement:
private theorem mem_princ_iff_pow_dvd_sub_one (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (m : ℕ) (u : ℤ_[l]ˣ) :
    u ∈ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l m ↔ (l : ℤ_[l]) ^ m ∣ (u : ℤ_[l]) - 1

powSucc.name: pow_succ_dvd_pow_prime_sub_one
powSucc.statement:
private theorem pow_succ_dvd_pow_prime_sub_one (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (j : ℕ) (v : ℤ_[l])
    (h : (l : ℤ_[l]) ^ (j + 1) ∣ v - 1) : (l : ℤ_[l]) ^ (j + 2) ∣ v ^ l - 1

qzTors.name: exists_prime_pow_smul_eq_zero_qz
qzTors.statement: private theorem exists_prime_pow_smul_eq_zero_qz (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (v : QZ l) : ∃ m : ℕ, (l : ℤ_[l]) ^ m • v = 0

princNhds.name: exists_princ_subset_of_mem_nhds_one
princNhds.statement:
private theorem exists_princ_subset_of_mem_nhds_one (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (V : Set ℤ_[l]ˣ) (hV : V ∈ nhds (1 : ℤ_[l]ˣ)) :
    ∃ n, ∀ u ∈ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l n, u ∈ V

dinfNil.name: Kum.dinfNil
dinfNil.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Kum.dinfNil :
    ∀ (F Ω : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω] [IsAlgClosure F Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (N : ℕ) (U : Subgroup (G F Ω)) [U.Normal], IsClosed (U : Set (G F Ω)) → ∀ φ ∈ Dinf l N U, (∃ n, ∀ g ∈ levU l U n, funRep ℤ_[l] (QZ l) (cycU l U) g φ = φ) ∧
    ∀ γ ∈ levU l U 1, ∃ k : ℕ, (l : ℤ_[l]) ^ k • φ = 0 ∧ ((funRep ℤ_[l] (QZ l) (cycU l U) γ - 1) ^ k) φ = 0

G.name: G
G.statement: abbrev G (F Ω : Type*) [Field F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω] := Ω ≃ₐ[F] Ω

QZ.name: QZ
QZ.statement: def QZ : Type := ℚ_[l] ⧸ ZlSub l

cycZ.name: Gal.cycZ

Dec.name: Gal.Dec
Dec.statement: def Dec (A : ValuationSubring (Ω)) : Subgroup (G F Ω) := A.decompositionSubgroup F

Ine.name: Gal.Ine
Ine.statement:
def Ine (A : ValuationSubring (Ω)) : Subgroup (G F Ω) where
  carrier := Inertia (F := F) A
  one_mem' := ⟨(Dec (F := F) A).one_mem, fun x _ => by simp⟩
  mul_mem' := by
    rintro σ τ ⟨hσ, hσ'⟩ ⟨hτ, hτ'⟩
    refine ⟨(Dec (F := F) A).mul_mem hσ hτ, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have e : (σ * τ) x - x = σ (τ x - x) + (σ x - x) := by
      simp [AlgEquiv.mul_apply, map_sub]
    rw [e]
    exact Valuation.map_add_lt _ ((valuation_apply_lt_one_iff hσ _).mpr (hτ' x hx)) (hσ' x hx)
  inv_mem' := by
    rintro σ ⟨hσ, hσ'⟩
    refine ⟨(Dec (F := F) A).inv_mem hσ, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have hy : A.valuation ((σ⁻¹ : G F Ω) x) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [A.valuation_le_one_iff, ← apply_mem_iff_of_mem_Dec hσ, mul_inv_apply]
      exact (A.valuation_le_one_iff x).mp hx
    have e : (σ⁻¹ : G F Ω) x - x = -(σ ((σ⁻¹ : G F Ω) x) - (σ⁻¹ : G F Ω) x) := by
      rw [mul_inv_apply]; ring
    rw [e, Valuation.map_neg]
    exact hσ' _ hy

princ.name: princ
princ.statement: noncomputable def princ (a : ℕ) : Subgroup ℤ_[l]ˣ := (redPow l a).ker

levU.name: Base.levU
levU.statement: def levU (U : Subgroup (G k Ω)) (n : ℕ) : Subgroup (G k Ω) := U ⊓ (KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l n).comap (cycZ k Ω l)

cycU.name: Base.cycU
cycU.statement: def cycU (U : Subgroup (G k Ω)) : Subgroup (G k Ω) := U ⊓ (cycZ k Ω l).ker

conjHom.name: Base.conjHom
conjHom.statement:
def conjHom (U : Subgroup G) [hU : U.Normal] (g : G) : U →* U where
  toFun u := ⟨g⁻¹ * u * g, by simpa using hU.conj_mem u u.2 g⁻¹⟩
  map_one' := Subtype.ext (by simp)
  map_mul' a b := Subtype.ext (by simp [mul_assoc])

conjDec.name: conjGal_mem_Dec
conjDec.statement:
theorem conjGal_mem_Dec (h : IsLift τ σ) {A A' : ValuationSubring Ω} (hA : ∀ x, σ x ∈ A' ↔ x ∈ A) {g : G F Ω}
    (hg : g ∈ Dec (F := F) A') : conjGal h g ∈ Dec (F := F) A

conjIne.name: conjGal_mem_Ine
conjIne.statement:
theorem conjGal_mem_Ine (h : IsLift τ σ) {A A' : ValuationSubring Ω} (hA : ∀ x, σ x ∈ A' ↔ x ∈ A) {g : G F Ω}
    (hg : g ∈ Ine (F := F) A') : conjGal h g ∈ Ine (F := F) A

xUnip.name: PropA.xUnip
xUnip.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.xUnip :
    ∀ (k Ω : Type) [Field k] [NumberField k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] [IsAlgClosure k Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (N : ℕ)
      (U : Subgroup (G k Ω)) [U.Normal], IsClosed (U : Set (G k Ω)) → Module.Finite ℤ_[l] (Xinf l N U) →
      ∀ γ ∈ levU l U 1, Unip (xRep l N U γ)

dualUnip.name: PropA.dualUnip
dualUnip.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.dualUnip :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (D : Type) [AddCommGroup D] [Module ℤ_[l] D] (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] D) (t : Module.End ℤ_[l] (D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l)),
      Module.Finite ℤ_[l] (D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l) → (∀ x φ, t x φ = x (g φ)) → (∀ φ : D, ∃ k : ℕ, ((g - 1) ^ k) φ = 0) → Unip t

shaDGen.name: Tower.shaDGen
shaDGen.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.shaDGen :
    ∀ (k Ω : Type) [Field k] [NumberField k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] [IsAlgClosure k Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (N : ℕ) (U V : Subgroup (G k Ω)) [U.Normal] (e : ℤ) (γ : G k Ω), IsClosed (U : Set (G k Ω)) → V ≤ U → IsGen l V γ →
        ShaD l N U V e = LinearMap.ker (dTw l N U e γ - 1) ∧ ShaD l N U V e = LinearMap.ker (dTw l N U e γ⁻¹ - 1)
